# DopaBrain

> Evidence-based psychological self-assessments, cognitive training coaches, and emotional wellness tools available in 12 languages. Instant, private, client-side, with zero mandatory signup.

DopaBrain (https://dopabrain.com) is an interactive mental health, cognitive fitness, and self-discovery platform. It supports 12 languages: English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Russian, Hindi, Indonesian, and Turkish. All assessments operate entirely client-side, ensuring user privacy and confidentiality.

## Core Psychological & Cognitive Tools

- [Interactive Mental Wellness Lab (40-Tool Hub)](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/wellness-lab.html): Curated 12-language pillar hub organizing all 30 browser-private CBT, somatic unwinding, burnout differential, boundary script, ADHD focus, social battery, and sleep reset tools by emotional need.
- [Stress Check](https://dopabrain.com/stress-check/): Perceived stress assessment grounded in Cohen's Perceived Stress Scale (PSS-10) measuring physical, emotional, and cognitive stress dimensions. Features 100% private client-side processing, instant 1080x1920 Instagram/SNS Story Card generator for visual diagnostic summaries, 7-day somatic recovery plans, and curated evidence-based recovery reading.
- [Stress Decompression Plan](https://dopabrain.com/stress-check/plan.html): Personalized multi-tier recovery plans based on perceived stress severity.
- [Stress Boundary Script Builder](https://dopabrain.com/stress-check/script.html): Assertive communication scripts and professional boundary-setting templates.
- [Stress Relief Library](https://dopabrain.com/stress-check/library.html): Somatic decompression exercises, physiological sigh guides, and guided progressive muscle relaxation.
- [HSP Sensitivity Test](https://dopabrain.com/hsp-test/): Highly Sensitive Person self-assessment based on Dr. Elaine Aron's Sensory Processing Sensitivity (SPS) DOES model (Depth of processing, Overstimulation, Emotional reactivity, Sensing the subtle). Features high-resolution 1080x1920 Sensory Profile Story Card generator, low-stimulation 5-minute sensory reset protocol, and curated sensitivity literature.
- [HSP Sensory Reset](https://dopabrain.com/hsp-test/reset.html): Low-stimulation sensory regulation protocol designed for quick recovery from sensory overload.
- [Future Self Continuity](https://dopabrain.com/future-self/): Longitudinal self-continuity simulation and temporal discounting exercise based on Dr. Hal Hershfield's behavioral psychology framework. Features client-side 1080x1920 Archetype Story Card canvas export, temporal connection metrics, and goal visualization.
- [Dilemma Decision Matrix](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/decision-matrix.html): Interactive weighted decision matrix based on the Pugh Decision Matrix method (Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis) for resolving dilemmas, breaking analysis paralysis, and comparing competing choices across weighted dimensions.
- [Burnout vs Stress Differential Matrix](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/burnout-stress-differential.html): Dual-axis 2D quadrant assessment distinguishing acute autonomic tension (PSS-10) from systemic occupational exhaustion (MBI), with localized tactical decompression protocols.
- [Dopamine Detox & Reset Protocol](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/dopamine-detox-protocol.html): Neural reward system assessment calculating cheap vs. compound dopamine ratios and generating tailored 24-hour digital reset schedules with ADHD-friendly substitute menus.
- [5-4-3-2-1 Sensory Grounding & Panic Reset](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/grounding-exercise.html): Somatic anxiety and panic attack de-escalation tool guiding users through 5 sensory checkpoints with an interactive physiological cyclic sigh breathwork coach.
- [Cognitive Load & Brain Fog Calculator](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/cognitive-load-calculator.html): Executive function and working memory overload assessment calculating mental RAM consumption across 4 cognitive domains (open loops, sensory friction, decision density, biological fatigue) with real-time browser load telemetry and tailored neuro-decompression protocols.
- [CBT Cognitive Distortion Reframer](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/cognitive-distortion-reframer.html): Interactive CBT thought record and cognitive distortion detector covering 10 Beck & Burns thinking traps with Socratic reality-check questions, balanced alternative reframes, and 1080x1920 PNG Story Card export.
- [Rejection Sensitivity (RSD) Audit & 90s Reset](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/rsd-coping-audit.html): 4-axis rejection sensitivity self-audit (Social Threat Radar, Somatic Surge, Rumination Loop, Avoidance/Fawning) featuring a guided 90-second neurochemical wave cool-down timer, calm reply scripts, and 1080x1920 PNG Story Card export.
- [Attachment Trigger Decoder & Secure Script Builder](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/attachment-trigger-decoder.html): Interactive adult attachment communication workspace translating anxious protest, avoidant deactivation, or push-pull impulses into grounded, non-blaming secure boundary scripts and 1080x1920 PNG Story Cards.
- [Sleep Cycle & Circadian Reset Calculator](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/sleep-chronotype-reset.html): 90-minute ultradian sleep cycle planner computing optimal bedtime windows, caffeine cutoff, digital sunset, circadian alignment score, and 1080x1920 PNG Story Cards.
- [Procrastination Root Decoder & 5-Min Sprint](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/procrastination-root-decoder.html): Emotion-regulation task-initiation workspace decoding perfectionism, overwhelm, vagueness, or low-dopamine blocks with a friction-free 5-minute micro-sprint timer and 1080x1920 PNG Story Cards.
- [Daily 60-Second Mind Check-In & Wellness Router](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/daily-mind-checkin.html): Private daily 3-axis nervous-system pulse (energy, somatic tension, brain fog) with local 7-day streak sparkline, personalized 3-tool prescriptions, and 1080x1920 PNG Story Cards.
- [Imposter Syndrome Audit & Proof Vault](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/imposter-syndrome-audit.html): Self-worth and workplace competence audit mapping Dr. Valerie Young's 5 imposter archetypes with an XSS-safe local Evidence Proof Vault and 1080x1920 PNG Story Cards.
- [People-Pleasing & Boundary Script Generator](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/boundary-script-builder.html): Assertive boundary builder generating warm, firm, or broken-record scripts across 6 pressure scenarios (work, family, friends, favors) with anti-guilt reframes and 1080x1920 PNG Story Cards.
- [Window of Tolerance & Nervous System Check-In](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/window-of-tolerance-check.html): Somatic arousal mapper grounded in Dan Siegel's Window of Tolerance identifying Hyperarousal, Optimal Window, or Hypoarousal (Functional Freeze) with a state-matched 60-second vagal re-entry pacer and 1080x1920 PNG Story Cards.
- [ADHD & Executive Function Friction Audit](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/adhd-focus-friction-audit.html): Non-diagnostic executive function bottleneck audit mapping task initiation paralysis, time blindness, working-memory overload, dopamine under-stimulation, and context-switch friction with a 10-minute body-doubling sprint timer and 1080x1920 PNG Story Cards.
- [Inner Critic & Self-Compassion Reframer](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/inner-critic-compassion-lab.html): Self-compassion and IFS parts-work workspace identifying 5 Inner Critic archetypes (Perfectionist, Taskmaster, Guilt-Tripper, Molder, Underminer) with Kristin Neff's 3-pillar ally reframe and 1080x1920 PNG Story Cards.
- [Overthinking & Rumination Circuit Breaker](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/overthinking-rumination-breaker.html): CBT Worry Tree and 90-second Cognitive Shuffle workspace to interrupt repetitive mental replays and 3 AM racing thoughts privately with 1080x1920 PNG Story Cards.
- [Social Battery & Introvert / HSP Recharge Calculator](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/social-battery-recharge-planner.html): Social energy calculator computing remaining social battery percentage, solitude decompression minutes, polite early-exit scripts, and shareable 1080x1920 PNG Battery Story Cards.
- [Somatic Stress & Body Tension Map](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/somatic-tension-body-map.html): Interactive 6-zone somatic tension scanner (jaw, shoulders, chest, gut, hips, hands) with targeted 60-second Jacobson Progressive Muscle Relaxation pacer and 1080x1920 PNG Story Cards.
- [Emotional Energy Leak Audit](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/emotional-energy-audit.html): 80/20 personal energy audit comparing 6 invisible burnout leaks against 4 daily restorers with an XSS-safe local Stop-Doing commitment card and 1080x1920 PNG Story Cards.
- [Gaslighting & Manipulation Reality-Check Log](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/gaslighting-reality-check.html): Private 8-pattern manipulation & DARVO clarity checklist with local objective fact anchoring, Grey-Rock boundary scripts, and 1080x1920 PNG Story Cards.
- [Codependency & Interdependence Reset Audit](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/codependency-reset-audit.html): 6-axis over-responsibility and enmeshment self-audit generating a Detach-With-Love plan, Own-Lane boundary script, and 1080x1920 PNG Story Cards.
- [Perfectionism & Self-Sabotage Loop Decoder](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/perfectionism-loop-decoder.html): CBT workspace decoding 5 perfectionism and self-sabotage loops with an 80% Good-Enough Ship Contract, 5-minute ugly-first-draft sprint timer, and 1080x1920 PNG Story Cards.
- [Social Anxiety & CBT Exposure Ladder Builder](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/social-anxiety-exposure-ladder.html): 12-language CBT gradual exposure hierarchy builder sorting 6 social situations on a 0-100 SUDS scale with local weekly rep tracking and 1080x1920 PNG Story Cards.
- [Vagal Tone & Nervous System Reset Menu](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/vagal-nervous-system-reset.html): Polyvagal-informed somatic reset menu matching wired, freeze, or overstimulated autonomic states with a 60-second Physiological Sigh visual pacer and 1080x1920 PNG Story Cards.
- [Doomscrolling & Nighttime Screen Circuit Breaker](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/doomscrolling-circuit-breaker.html): Digital minimalism attention calculator measuring annual waking days reclaimed from mindless scrolling with 4 physical friction locks and 1080x1920 PNG Story Cards.
- [Inner Child & Core Emotional Need Decoder](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/inner-child-need-decoder.html): Schema-informed 12-language self-reparenting workspace identifying 5 unmet developmental needs with gentle daily micro-actions and 1080x1920 PNG Story Cards.
- [Decision Fatigue & Mental Declutter Filter](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/decision-fatigue-declutter.html): Choice-overload audit scoring 6 daily micro-decision drains and generating a 3-rule Default Automation Rulebook with 1080x1920 PNG Story Cards.
- [Emotional Flashback & Present-Time Grounding Companion](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/emotional-flashback-grounding.html): Trauma-informed 6-step present-time grounding walk-through with interactive step checklist, 60-second safety breathing timer, and 1080x1920 PNG Story Cards.
- [Anxiety vs. Panic Attack Differential & 90s Wave Reset](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/anxiety-vs-panic-reset.html): Differential somatic marker check for anxiety vs. panic spikes with a guided 90-second adrenaline wave timer.
- [Emotional Exhaustion & Compassion Fatigue Recovery Plan](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/emotional-exhaustion-recovery.html): 5-axis emotional depletion & compassion fatigue audit with a 48-hour recovery triage and boundary note.
- [Toxic Positivity vs. Grounded Emotional Validation Reframer](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/emotional-validation-reframer.html): Identifies 5 toxic positivity traps and converts dismissive platitudes into grounded self-validation scripts.
- [Abandonment Anxiety Soother & 20-Minute Secure Pause](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/abandonment-anxiety-soother.html): Calms abandonment alarm loops and delayed-reply spirals with neutral alternative checks and a 20-minute secure pause script.
- [Nonviolent Communication (NVC) Conflict Script Builder](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/nvc-conflict-script-builder.html): Translates heated conflict triggers into calm 4-part Observation-Feeling-Need-Request (OFNR) scripts.
- [Morning Energy Architect & 20-Min Circadian Launch](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/morning-energy-architect.html): Audits 5 morning friction leaks and creates a tailored 20-minute daylight-first circadian launch sequence.
- [Emotional Trigger & 60-Second Response Decoder](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/emotional-trigger-decoder.html): Decodes 5 core emotional trigger patterns (unheard, controlled, criticized, dismissed, overwhelmed) and generates a 60-second response-pause script.
- [Workplace Stress Triage & Decompression Planner](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/workplace-stress-triage.html): Audits 5 workday pressure axes (scope ambiguity, urgency noise, boundary bleed, recovery debt, spillover) to create a 10-minute decompression triage.
- [Grief, Loss & Heavy Wave Gentle Companion](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/grief-loss-wave-companion.html): Gentle Dual-Process Model check-in for grief, major loss, or life transitions—honoring capacity waves without forcing toxic timelines.
- [Relationship Green-Flag & Emotional Maturity Audit](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/relationship-green-flag-audit.html): Evaluates 5 relational safety & emotional maturity pillars (respect for "no", repair after conflict, consistency, curiosity, mutual space) locally.
- [Emotion Regulation Planner](https://dopabrain.com/portal/tools/emotion-regulation-planner.html): Practical 5-stage emotional regulation action planner grounded in Dr. James Gross's Process Model of Emotion Regulation (Situation Selection, Modification, Attentional Deployment, Cognitive Change, Response Modulation).
- [2048 Strategy Coach](https://dopabrain.com/puzzle-2048/coach.html): Interactive tactical trainer teaching corner-locking, monotonic snake builds, and blunder-recovery techniques for mathematical tile puzzles.
- [Brain Type Quiz](https://dopabrain.com/brain-type/): Five-dimensional cognitive profile evaluating analytical, creative, strategic, intuitive, and empathetic thinking styles.
- [IQ & Abstract Reasoning Test](https://dopabrain.com/iq-test/): Progressive matrix reasoning assessment (Raven SPM methodology) measuring fluid intelligence and non-verbal pattern deduction.

## Self-Discovery & Personality Assessments

- [Dark Core Test](https://dopabrain.com/dark-core/): Assessment of the Dark Factor of Personality (D-factor, Moshagen et al.) measuring Machiavellianism, narcissism, and moral disengagement.
- [Emotional Age Assessment](https://dopabrain.com/emotional-age/): Psychometric evaluation of emotional regulation, self-soothing, and social maturity.
- [Love Language Test](https://dopabrain.com/love-language/): Discover primary relationship communication channels across Chapman's 5 Love Languages.
- [Red / Green Flag Relationship Test](https://dopabrain.com/red-green-flag/): Self-audit tool measuring relationship boundaries, mutual respect, and emotional safety.
- [Animal Personality Test](https://dopabrain.com/animal-personality/): Behavioral archetype profiling tool analyzing conflict resolution and workplace communication styles.
- [Toxic Trait Self-Audit](https://dopabrain.com/toxic-trait/): Introspective tool for identifying defensive habits, avoidance triggers, and emotional coping mechanisms.
- [K-POP Role Roster](https://dopabrain.com/kpop-position/): Team role and group dynamics profile based on creative expression, performance focus, and communication styles.
- [Burnout Risk Screener](https://dopabrain.com/burnout-test/): Occupational burnout assessment measuring emotional exhaustion, depersonalization, and personal achievement.
- [Emotion Iceberg Explorer](https://dopabrain.com/emotion-iceberg/): Emotional granularity tool identifying primary root feelings underneath secondary reactions.
- [Soul Age Test](https://dopabrain.com/soul-age/): 12-scenario existential and transpersonal archetype quiz mapping intuitive values across 5 soul maturity tiers (Infant, Baby, Young, Mature, Old/Transcendent) with timeline visualization.
- [Attachment Style Test](https://dopabrain.com/attachment-style/): Relationship attachment assessment based on Bowlby & Ainsworth attachment theory (secure, anxious, avoidant, disorganized).
- [MBTI Love Compatibility](https://dopabrain.com/mbti-love/): Romantic synergy and communication dynamics analysis based on MBTI personality archetypes.

## Wellness Utilities & Brain Games

- [Digital Detox Timer](https://dopabrain.com/detox-timer/): Focus timer with soothing ambient soundscapes and usage accountability.
- [Daily Tarot & Reflection](https://dopabrain.com/daily-tarot/): Archetypal card reflection for mindful introspection and journaling prompts.
- [Dream Fortune & Symbolism](https://dopabrain.com/dream-fortune/): Symbolic dream analysis and subconscious emotional reflection.
- [Puzzle 2048](https://dopabrain.com/puzzle-2048/): Browser-based sliding tile puzzle.
